name: Meitantei Conan: Aoki Houseki no Rondo
original_name: 名探偵コナン 蒼き宝石の輪舞曲
source:
Onimaru is a TV show superhero that isn't that popular. They decide one day to hop off the TV station escape. At the same time, Toma Katsuragi, the actor playing Onimaru, asks Kogoro to investigate the disappearance of the costume for him, but too late, as he is killed by Onimaru just a while later.

[From [url=https://www.detectiveconanworld.com/wiki/Detective_Conan:_The_Blue_Jewel%27s_Rondo]Detective Conan World[/url]]
translation:
鬼丸是一个不太受欢迎的电视节目超级英雄。他们决定有一天从电视台跳下逃亡。与此同时，扮演鬼丸的演员葛城斗真要求小五郎帮他调查服装失踪的情况，但为时已晚，因为不久之后他就被鬼丸杀死了。

[来自[url=https://www.detectiveconanworld.com/wiki/Detective_Conan:_The_Blue_Jewel%27s_Rondo]名侦探柯南世界[/url]]
